protocol_hash_definition: SHA-256 of parsed JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8
scope: One person, one session, left hand, disjoint stage recordings. Custom pilot, not the official generalization benchmark.

timing.definition: Unbatched trailing-window feature extraction plus prediction; excludes HDF5 I/O, corruption, eligibility, replay scheduling, output serialization, and simulated waiting. Five warm repeated passes.
timing.replay_scheduling: No wall-clock stream scheduler; offline iteration only.
